annotations.title: Get a nursing home's daily staffing record

description: The tool gets a nursing home's staffing from Medicare's Payroll Based Journal by the home's six-character CCN. It returns every held quarter's summary, including nurse hours per resident per day, registered nurse hours, weekend hours, days with residents and no registered nurse hours, and contract staff share when the build carries it. It returns daily points for one quarter. Without a quarter (YYYYQn), it returns the newest quarter's daily points. A figure CMS does not publish, or a figure under the 11-person floor, is null and never zero.

ccn.description: The nursing home's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN), such as 015009.

quarter.description: A quarter as YYYYQn, such as 2026Q2. Omit it for the newest quarter.

name: get_nursing_home_staffing
title: Get a nursing home's daily staffing record
